entries.reason: Store metadata and entries now use typed Protobuf binary and JSON snapshots while values remain open-ended runtime data.
entries.schema: statepatch:store version 2 stores revision, next sequence, entries and dirty keys in StatePatchStoreSave; each open-ended value uses eve.persistence.proto.DynamicValue.
entries.version: Binary and Protobuf JSON writers emit version 2; legacy version 1 JSON and common envelopes remain readable.
entries.migration: The version 1 to 2 envelope migration validates legacy JSON in a detached Store and recaptures its typed payload.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively; typed Protobuf JSON rejects unknown names, and the legacy parser retains its strict required-field checks.
entries.restore_atomicity: Restore validates every entry and dirty key into detached containers, then replaces the live Store and invalidates old handles only after success.

entries.reason: The Store exposes typed Protobuf binary persistence beside its compatibility JSON and script interfaces.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this persistence change.

entries.thread_affinity: Store capture and restore run on the owning thread; restore invokes no callbacks.
cost_notes: Binary capture and restore cost linear time in the stored keys and recursively owned values per operation.
